review_comments.body:
🟡 [Guidelines] FETCH_ONE happy path untested
Problem: Only the empty case is covered; no test that runs in CI checks that `FETCH_ONE` still returns the best match and the total `size` when matches exist (the only other Search test needs an Ollama container and uses `FETCH`), so a regression on the non-empty branch would go unnoticed.
Fix: Add a second test in this class that seeds an `InMemoryEmbeddingStore` with two segments through a provider returning that store, runs `FETCH_ONE`, and asserts `results` has exactly the top match and `size` is 2.

🟢 [Guidelines] fetchType doc does not mention the empty case
Problem: The `fetchType` `@Schema` says `FETCH_ONE` returns the single best match, but with no match it now returns an empty `results` list, which users of `{{ outputs.<id>.results[0] }}` need to know.
Fix: Extend the `fetchType` description: `FETCH_ONE` returns the single best match, or an empty list when nothing matches.
